subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Luxuriant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Flourishing**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Luxuriant **means growing thickly and strongly in an attractive way. (एक आकर्षक तरीके से मोटे तौर पर और मजबूती से बढ़ रहा है)

 
 
• Example -* Her **luxuriant **hair fell around her shoulders.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Flourishing **means to be strong and healthy; to develop in a successful way. (सशक्त होते जाना; फलना-फूलना; सफलता की ओर अग्रसर होना; उन्‍नति करना)
 
 
• Example -* Your **flourishing **lemonade stand is especially busy on hot summer afternoons.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Luxuriant**' and '**Flourishing**' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 3.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Meagre **means very small in amount or number or not enough in amount or number. (राशि या संख्या में बहुत कम या राशि या संख्या में पर्याप्त नहीं)
 
• **Sparse **means small in quantity or amount. (मात्रा या मात्रा में छोटा)
 
• **Combative **means ready or eager to fight or argue.. (लड़ने या बहस करने के लिए तैयार या उत्सुक)
